verdict.rationale: Cognee documents a multi-user permissions system with dataset-scoped permissions and per-dataset storage that isolates data between users and organizations. The forget operation is scoped to what the current user can delete, and the founder separately describes per-user graphs with user permissions plus graph filtering. That covers the core of read/write governance, but the evidence never shows roles, policies, ACL granularity, or any audit capability. Missing for 10: documented role or policy definitions and ACL grants, audit logging of memory access, independent hands-on corroboration.
